notes: KaGuYa: .arc archives come PAIRED with .ari indexes (magic WFL1), and the family also uses LIN2/LINK3/LINK5/LINK6/UF01 .arc variants (https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html); message.dat is its script file (https://github.com/arcusmaximus/VNTranslationTools). .ari is KaGuYa-only in GARbro's table, .arc alone is not, hence the pairing.
